WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

3. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

4. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

5. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

6. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

7. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.

8. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

12. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Manufactured boards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. B — Information and Communication Technology

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

9. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

11. D — CPU

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
